Why Bay Breeze

A patient, teacher-first approach to buying

Whether you are bidding on your first condo or finding a waterfront house, we explain every step so you feel completely in control.

01

Zero High-Pressure Sales

No pushy tactics or rushed deadlines. We take the time to answer every question and make sure you feel confident.

02

Deep Local Roots

We live and work right here in Alameda and Oakland, knowing every micro-market, block, and waterfront nook.

03

Plain-English Guidance

We translate complex contracts and closing documents into clear language so you always know what you are signing.

04

Fun Weekend Crawls

Our popular open house tours turn weekend home-shopping into a collaborative, stress-free neighborhood adventure.

The Journey

How we guide you home

1

First-Time Workshop

Join our free monthly class at the library to learn the ropes before you even look at a listing.

2

Open House Crawls

Hop on our weekend tours to explore neighborhoods and see what your budget actually buys.

3

Plain-English Offers

We map out a smart offer strategy and walk you through every line of the contract together.

4

We cross the finish line together, grab a coffee, and celebrate getting you the keys.
